title: Ridgeline Installation Services Customer Reschedule Fee Amount
content:
**Amount.** The customer reschedule fee is the program's reschedule fee for the installation program on the contract, rounded to the cent.

## Terms used

- **The installation program on the contract** is the Ridgeline Installation Services program named on the contract record (carpet, hard surface flooring, window and door, kitchen cabinet and countertop, bath remodel, or roofing and siding installation). It is the program of the contract that carries the reschedule, whatever other contracts the customer holds.
- **The program's reschedule fee** is that program's reschedule fee figure in the program table of installation date booking terms.
- **Rounding.** The fee is a dollar amount rounded to the cent.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

| Program reschedule fee | Customer reschedule fee |
|---|---|
| 150.00 | 150.00 |
| 75.00 | 75.00 |

## Basis questions answered

**Two contracts at one address were both rescheduled. Which program's figure applies to each?** Each contract carries its own customer reschedule fee, worked from the reschedule fee of the program on that contract.

**Is the fee paid at the moment of the reschedule?** The fee is charged to the contract and raises its balance due; it is a charge on the contract, not a separate payment.
